Anita M: Quick ask — we need a prioritized set of design assets for the April 8 launch. Main focus: benchmark hero graphic, 3 social tiles, a webinar hero, and a gated one-pager. Can design confirm what you need from us and estimated TAT? :eyes:

Marta (DesignOps): Thanks Anita — can you list formats + sizes? also any copy variations or localization needed?

Anita M: Top-level: hero (1920x1080), webinar hero (1200x628), social tiles (3 sizes: 1200x1200, 1080x1920 story, 800x800 for older ad slots), gated one-pager PDF A4 + US Letter. Copy: 2 headline variants (bench-cost-focus, reliability-focus) + 1 short subhead. No localization for V1.

Rashid (Growth): Add: we need a 600x315 email hero and a 600x200 banner for partners. Also, please export a lightweight PNG fallback for the hero for email clients.

Marta (DesignOps): Got it. Do we have brand guardrail constraints? color palettes, mandatory logos, and the Redwood benchmark diagram assets?

Anita M: Use latest brand kit (link: https://drive.redwood/brand/2026-spring). Mandatory: full logo + small lockup for gated asset, and the 'inference economics' icon set. No new illustrations.

Marta (DesignOps): Ok. Prioritization proposal: 1) benchmark hero (2 copies: cost + latency) — deliver PNG/SVG + Figma file, 2) social tile set (3 variants) — deliver PNG + source components, 3) webinar hero + email hero — deliver sizes, 4) gated one-pager PDF — deliver final + editable InDesign/Figma, 5) partner banner and fallback PNGs. ETA: benchmark hero & one social variant in 48 hours if copy is locked. Full set in 6 business days.

Anita M: 48h for hero sounds great. Copy locked now — I'll paste below.

Anita M: HEADLINE A: "Cut inference costs by 3x — without sacrificing latency"
HEADLINE B: "Consistent latency at scale: benchmarks that matter"
SUBHEAD: "Redwood Inference — predictable, economical LLM serving for product teams."

Kai L: small note — for the benchmark hero can we surface a 3-metric sparkline (latency, cost/token, throughput) as a compact panel? We have sample CSVs: https://data.redwood/bench/apr-2026.csv

Marta (DesignOps): Perfect. We'll design a compact 3-metric panel. Any constraints on data freshness callout? e.g., "based on public workloads" vs "internal benchmark"

Anita M: Use "based on representative production workloads" — legal OK. Also add a small footnote: "Model: gpt-neox-XX, seq 1024"

DesignOps Bot: New asset request created: #ASSET-4872. Status: queued. Designers assigned: Kai L. Due: 1769640000.

Rashid (Growth): For copy variants — we should test HEADLINE A on paid channels, HEADLINE B for organic. Good to have both exports labeled clearly (A / B).

Marta (DesignOps): Noted. We'll include filename suffix _A and _B, and a Figma page with grouped components for quick swaps. Also will include an accessibility color-contrast check and a brand compliance checklist in the delivery zip.

Anita M: One more ask — can we get a small editable diagram (vector) showing "serving modes" (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) for the one-pager? It should be simple, 3 columns with short bullets.

Marta (DesignOps): Yes — we'll add a 3-column vector diagram + plain-text bullets so marketing can copy into the gated PDF.

Kai L: Quick Q on the sparkline data — do we want absolute numbers or indexed change? Indexed looks cleaner for hero. I'll mock both.

Anita M: Indexed please. Show relative savings vs baseline.

Rashid (Growth): Delivery checklist for launch ops: name exports like: hero_cost_A.png, hero_latency_B.svg, social_tile_1200x1200_A.png, webinar_1200x628_v1.png, gated_onepager_v1_A.pdf. Also include README.md with usage, alt text, and CTA copy.

Marta (DesignOps): Great. Will produce README and brand checklist. Will ping when initial hero comps are ready for review. :sparkles:

Anita M: Thanks team — please @mention me in the review thread.

DesignOps Bot: Asset #ASSET-4872 status updated: in review (1769610000).
